name: Karmic Fire of the Distant Shore
description: A ring formed of three clusters of karmic fire. When equipped, it hovers behind the wearer as a back accessory.
story: The flames of wrath ignites, proclaiming that he has cast aside his obsessions and vowed to point his honed blade — forged in rebirth and tempered a thousand times into its sharpest form — directly at the source of all tragedy.
